params.name: DynamicTFollow
params.title: Dynamic TFollow
params.descr: Dynamically adjusts following distance based on changes in lead vehicle motion
params.edescr: Dynamically adjusts following distance based on changes in lead vehicle motion
params.cdescr: 根据前车加减速变化动态调整跟车时间。值越高，动态调整幅度越明显。

params.name: EnableSpeedTF
params.title: EnableSpeedTF(0)
params.descr:
-1:0/30/60/90km/h steps
-2:0/40/80/120km/h steps
-3:0/50/100/150km/h steps
1~50%:Reduce TF below 100km/h
params.edescr:
-1:0/30/60/90km/h steps
-2:0/40/80/120km/h steps
-3:0/50/100/150km/h steps
1~50%:Reduce TF below 100km/h
params.cdescr: 按车速分段调整跟车时间。-1/-2/-3 使用不同车速分段；1-50 表示在 100km/h 以下按比例缩短跟车时间。

params.name: DynamicTFollowLC
params.title: Dynamic TFollow LaneChange(100)%
params.descr: Temporarily reduces the gap between vehicles when starting a lane change
params.edescr: Temporarily reduces the gap between vehicles when starting a lane change
params.cdescr: 变道开始时临时缩短跟车时间，让变道衔接更积极。数值越低，临时车距越短；默认不建议激进调整。

params.name: TFollowDecelBoost
params.title: Decel TF Boost Ratio (30)
params.descr: Extra t_follow boost ratio during deceleration. Higher values keep more following distance while slowing down.
params.edescr: Extra t_follow boost ratio during deceleration. Higher values keep more following distance while slowing down.
params.cdescr: 减速时额外增加跟车时间的比例。数值越大，减速时与前车保持得越远。

params.name: AutoCurveSpeedLowerLimit
params.title: AutoCurveSpeed LowerLimit(30)
params.descr: Minimum speed allowed during automatic curve slowdown. Lower values allow stronger slowdown in curves.
params.edescr: Minimum speed allowed during automatic curve slowdown. Lower values allow stronger slowdown in curves.
params.cdescr: 自动弯道减速时允许降到的最低速度。值越低，弯道中允许减速越多；过低可能影响后车体验。

params.name: StoppingAccel
params.title: StoppingStartAccelx0.01(0)
params.descr: stopping acceleration, 0: Traditional method
params.edescr: stopping acceleration, 0: Traditional method
params.cdescr: 停止加速度，0: 传统方式

params.name: MyDrivingMode
params.title: DrivingMode:Init(3)
params.descr: Initial longitudinal driving mode. 1: Economy, 2: Safety, 3: Normal, 4: High speed/aggressive. Use 3 until road-tested.
params.edescr: Initial longitudinal driving mode. 1: Economy, 2: Safety, 3: Normal, 4: High speed/aggressive. Use 3 until road-tested.
params.cdescr: 纵向控制的初始驾驶模式。1: 经济，2: 安全，3: 普通，4: 高速/更激进。未完成路测前建议保持 3。

params.name: MyDrivingModeAuto
params.title: DrivingMode: Auto
params.descr: Safety mode in Congested Conditions; Normal mode when lead vehicle accelerates quickly or 20+km/h.
params.edescr: Safety mode in Congested Conditions; Normal mode when lead vehicle accelerates quickly or 20+km/h.
params.cdescr: 拥堵路况进入安全模式；前车加速快或速度超过 20km/h 时进入普通模式

params.name: TrafficLightDetectMode
params.title: TrafficLightDetectMode
params.descr: Traffic-light handling mode. Requires reliable traffic-light detection before using stop-and-go behavior.
params.edescr: Traffic-light handling mode. Requires reliable traffic-light detection before using stop-and-go behavior.
params.cdescr: 红绿灯处理模式。只有在红绿灯识别稳定后才建议使用停车起步。0: 不使用，1: 仅停车，2: 停车并起步。

params.name: AutoNaviSpeedCtrlEnd
params.title: NaviSpeedEndingPoint(6s)
params.descr: Time until decel completes, based on speed x time
params.edescr: Time until decel completes, based on speed x time
params.cdescr: 导航减速预计在目标点前后多少秒完成；值越大，越早开始收尾，过小可能减速太晚。

params.name: AutoNaviSpeedCtrlMode
params.title: NaviSpeedControlMode(2)
params.descr: 0: Not Use, 1: Speed cam, 2: cam + speed bump, 3: cam + bump + apn speed cam
params.edescr: 0: Not Use, 1: Speed cam, 2: cam + speed bump, 3: cam + bump + apn speed cam
params.cdescr: 选择哪些导航事件触发自动减速。0: 不使用，1: 限速摄像头，2: 摄像头+减速带，3: 摄像头+减速带+APN/移动摄像头。

params.name: EnableAmapNaviStatus
params.title: AmapNavi Status Compat(0)
params.descr: Publishes read-only fishop AmapNavi-compatible lane/blind status. Does not enable app commands, external blinker control, or overtake.
params.edescr: Publishes read-only fishop AmapNavi-compatible lane/blind status. Does not enable app commands, external blinker control, or overtake.
params.cdescr: 实验兼容项，默认关闭。开启后只把现有车道线和原车盲区状态发布为 AmapNavi 兼容消息；不接收 APP 命令，不控制外接转向灯，不启用自动超车。

params.name: AutoRoadSpeedLimitOffset
params.title: RoadSpeedLimitOffset(-1)
params.descr: RoadLimitSpeed+Set Value, -1:Not Use
params.edescr: RoadLimitSpeed+Set Value, -1:Not Use
params.cdescr: 按道路限速生成目标巡航速度时增加的偏移量；-1: 不使用道路限速自动匹配。

params.name: AutoNaviSpeedBumpTime
params.title: SpeedBumpEndingPoint(1s)
params.descr: Seconds after passing a speed bump before speed-bump deceleration ends. Too low may resume too early.
params.cdescr: 减速带通过后约多少秒结束减速控制；值过小可能恢复太早。

params.name: AutoNaviSpeedBumpSpeed
params.title: SpeedBumpSpeed(35km/h)
params.descr: Target speed for navigation-recognized speed bumps. Applies only when navigation speed-bump data is reliable.
params.cdescr: 导航识别到减速带时的目标通过速度。只在导航/减速带数据可靠时生效。

params.name: AutoNaviSpeedDecelRate
params.title: NaviSpeedDecelRate 0.01m/s^2x(200)
params.descr: The lower the value, the further away it decelerates.
params.edescr: The lower the value, the further away it decelerates.
params.cdescr: 导航限速/摄像头减速使用的减速度，单位为 0.01m/s²。值越低减速越早、更柔和；值越高减速越晚、更急。

params.name: AutoNaviCountDownMode
params.title: NaviCountDownMode
params.descr: 0:not use, 1: turn point + speed, 2: turn point + speed + bump
params.edescr: 0:not use, 1: turn point + speed, 2: turn point + speed + bump
params.cdescr: 导航提示倒计时显示内容。0: 不显示，1: 转向点+限速，2: 转向点+限速+减速带。

params.name: TurnSpeedControlMode
params.title: TurnSpeedControlMode
params.descr: 0:not use, 1:vision, 2:vision+route, 3:route(always)
params.edescr: 0:not use, 1:vision, 2:vision+route, 3:route(always)
params.cdescr: 弯道/转向减速来源。0: 不使用，1: 视觉模型，2: 视觉模型+导航路线(TBT)，3: 仅按导航路线持续控制。

params.name: MapTurnSpeedFactor
params.title: MapTurnSpeedFactor
params.descr: The smaller the value, the more the speed will decrease along the route.
params.edescr: The smaller the value, the more the speed will decrease along the route.
params.cdescr: 导航路线转弯减速比例。值越小，按路线减速越多；需要 CP搭子/APN 路线数据可靠。

params.name: ModelTurnSpeedFactor
params.title: ModelTurnSpeed time(0)x0.1sec
params.descr: future model speed
params.edescr: future model speed
params.cdescr: 使用模型预测的未来弯道速度参与减速的时间窗口，单位 0.1 秒。0 表示不使用模型转弯速度。

params.name: AutoNaviSpeedSafetyFactor
params.title: NaviSpeedLimitRatio(105)%
params.descr: Reduce speed to the road speed limit*set value at the speed camera
params.edescr: Reduce speed to the road speed limit*set value at the speed camera
params.cdescr: 限速摄像头目标速度比例。例如 105 表示按道路限速的 105% 控制。

params.name: ShowCustomBrightness
params.title: Onroad Screen Brightness(100%)
params.descr:
Screen brightness ratio ~10s after driving starts
0: Auto adjust by ambient light
100: Always max brightness
params.edescr:
Screen brightness ratio ~10s after driving starts
0: Auto adjust by ambient light
100: Always max brightness
params.cdescr:
行车开始约10秒后的屏幕亮度比例
0: 根据环境亮度自动调节
100: 始终最大亮度

params.name: ShowModelView
params.title: Onroad Display Mode(C4)
params.descr:
Display mode when onroad screen brightness reaches the configured level
0: Show camera and model
1: Show camera only
2: Show model only
3: Hide camera and model
params.edescr:
Display mode when onroad screen brightness reaches the configured level
0: Show camera and model
1: Show camera only
2: Show model only
3: Hide camera and model
params.cdescr: C4/外接显示相关的行车画面显示方式。只有屏幕亮度降到设定值附近时生效；C3 主屏日常保持默认。0: 摄像头+模型，1: 仅摄像头，2: 仅模型，3: 隐藏摄像头和模型。

params.name: ClusterHud
params.title: External HUD Display(0)

0: Off

2: TURZX 12.3 inch
params.edescr:
0: Off

2: TURZX 12.3 inch
params.cdescr: 外接 TURZX HUD/小屏开关，默认关闭。没有对应硬件时保持 0。开启后 manager 才会启动 cluster HUD 进程。0: 关闭，1: TURZX 9.2 英寸，2: TURZX 12.3 英寸。

params.name: ClusterHudDebug
params.title: External HUD Debug(0)
params.descr:
0: Onroad only
1: Always

3: Always + Navi
params.edescr:
0: Onroad only

3: Always + Navi
params.ctitle: 外部 HUD 调试模式(0)

params.name: ClusterHudBrightness
params.title: External HUD Brightness(0)
params.descr:
0: Auto
1-100: Brightness
params.edescr:
0: Auto
1-100: Brightness

2: Light

params.name: ClusterHudRadarInfo
